text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF are in the middle of a short term range and will look to a pivotal level at 129.14 to determine future direction, technical analyst said.
"It is really make your mind up time, are we going to correct lower or are we just going to consolidate?," said David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston.
He said while the contract was below the 129.14 area the immediate pressure was for a correction lower.
At 0808 GMT, September notionnel futures were at 128.98, up 10 basis points on the day.
A move to the downside would meet initial support at 128.78, with a further support area at 128.66/60, Sneddon said.
"If we see it back below there then we are really within the realms of a correction phase lower and we are looking at 128.46, and then key support at 128.40 and potentially lower than that," he said.
But if the contract managed to break above 129.14, an area of price resistance, Sneddon said it could then retest the recent high of 129.52.
"On the initial move that will cap the upside," he said. "I wouldn't be looking for an agressive move through 129.52."
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said channel support came in at 128.68 and a break beneath there would trigger a move down to 128.18.

"Such a move signifies more damage to the bullish structures and possibly and end to this overall bullish move, with trading centring on 127.78, a retracement and mid-point of a previous triangle," they said in a research note.
To the upside they said initial gains would take notionnel to 129.16 and once that was overcome an Elliott wave extension at 129.64 was a possible target.
September Pibor futures were at 96.53, down 0.02 on the day.
